services.name: Dafuskie Island Ferry
services.desc: Welcome aboard Savannah Harbor Cruises! We are thrilled to offer our ferry service from the enchanting city of Savannah, Georgia, to the picturesque Daufuskie Island, South Carolina. As you embark on this unforgettable journey, prepare to be captivated by the breathtaking coastal scenery and the tranquil views of the intracoastal waterways. Once you arrive on Daufuskie Island, the adventure continues with the option to rent a 4-seater golf cart for just $85.00. This allows you to explore the island at your own pace, uncovering its rich history, hidden gems, and pristine beaches. services.name: Port Tour of Savannah
services.desc: Book Online and Skip The Line! Duration 1.5 Hours. About Step aboard the River Explorer and head northwest up the Savannah River under the Talmadge Memorial Bridge as we approach Port of Savannah, the single largest and fastest-growing container terminal in all of America! With over 37 weekly vessel calls, you are likely to have a mammoth containership cruising right next to you as we make our way up the river. On this tour you will learn about the history of the Port of Savannah and what it has done for the state of Georgia, and all of America. services.name: Sunset Dolphin Eco Tour
services.desc: Book Online and Skip The Line! Duration 2 Hours. About The only thing that could make a day spent in Savannah better is to finish it off on the water with a breathtaking sunset surrounded by the natural beauty of the Lowcountry waterways! Come join the Captain and Crew aboard the River Explorer as they depart River Street in search of the local Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins! On this tour you will learn the history of Savannah and its surrounding waterways by your Captain and First Mate. This tour will cover all aspects of our Lowcountry ecosystem and will conclude with a picturesque sunset view of Savannah as we make our way up the river to port. This tour is fun for all ages.
